podcast.title: Paternity of Daisy Lowe
podcast.body: Fifteen years after their encounter, blood tests confirmed that Gavin Rossdale was the biological father of Daisy Lowe, who was born on January 27, 1989. Daisy's birth certificate had initially listed Pearl Lowe's husband as the father. "15 years later, Little Daisy started asking some interesting and awkward questions about dad. Like, is daddy my real dad? That kind of thing. Blood tests were done. And guess what? Gavin was the daddy."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Previous Relationship with Pearl Lowe
podcast.body: Before his fame with Bush in the 1990s, Gavin Rossdale had a relationship with Pearl Lowe, a singer, songwriter, and fashion designer. They had a one-night stand in the spring of 1988 while Pearl was married, but not to Gavin. "But before then he was in a relationship with a woman named Pearl Low."

podcast.body: Gavin Rossdale is reportedly quite proud of his long-lost daughter, Daisy Lowe, despite the complexities of her paternity being revealed years later. "Dad is apparently quite proud of his long lost daughter."
